betCard.$description: The betslip selection card — one bet (event + market + outcome + odds), the core repeating block of the betslip. Two densities share one anatomy: `compact` (Combo/System — odds sits inline to the right of the outcome, no stake field) and `amount` (Single — a Bet-amount field to the right of the outcome column). Header, market and outcome roles are identical across both. Built on Card's surface/border/radius language (surface.card + outline.default) but a dedicated component: it fixes a specific header/market/outcome/odds layout Card has no opinion on. Radius/padding/rhythm per Figma spec (radius.md, 8px padding, 8/4 vertical rhythm). Odds movement colours (up/down/changed) and the LIVE/FB/BB badges and suspended/error states are deliberately OUT of this first pass — they become the separate Odds component + Badge variants + card states.

radius.$description: 12px — a touch rounder than the 8px go-to (Card/Button), matching the betslip cards' softer corner.

bg.$description: The card sits on the page (surface.page); it is the first elevation, surface.card — same as Card.

padding.$description: 8px inner padding (Figma spec) — tighter than Card's 16px because betslip cards stack densely.

gap.$description: 8px between the leading icon, event link and remove ×.

color.$description: Muted grey — chrome icon, not content.

type.$description: 12px underlined link — the event is tappable (opens the event page); truncates with ellipsis.

color.$description: Secondary grey; the outcome below is the emphasised line, not the event name.

radius.$description: 6px — subtle rounding on the hover square.

hoverFill.$description: 12% white lighten on hover — the dark-surface hover overlay, same as every other icon button.

type.$description: 12px regular — the market name (e.g. 'Match Winner'), muted; truncates.

color.$description: Gold/warning — flags a market with special settlement rules; tapping opens the rich tooltip. Plain markets have no info icon.

type.$description: 14px bold (weight.bold = the odds/team-name strong step) — the selected outcome, the card's emphasised line. Composed inline: no text-style pairs bold weight with a non-caps body size.

16px bold, tabular-nums — the odds value. A hair larger than the outcome so the number reads first. This first pass is the static value only; movement (up/down/changed, struck-through old value) becomes the separate Odds component and recolours to text.positive/text.negative there.

amount.$description: The per-selection Bet-amount field (Single/`amount` density only). A floating-label box inset in the card: darker than the card (surface.page) so it reads as an input well, not another card. The ticket-notched silhouette from Figma is deferred to the Input component's bet-amount variant — this pass uses a clean rounded well.

bg.$description: Darker than the card — an inset input well on surface.card.

focusBorder.$description: Active-colour border on focus — same focus cue as every field.
